name: ai-tracking-system
description: Desktop mission control for running many AI coding chats in parallel on one project: a task graph, live status reports from agents, and copy-ready prompts.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @aitrack/ui && npm run build -w @aitrack/server && npm run build -w @aitrack/desktop
scripts.serve: npm run build -w @aitrack/ui && npm run build -w @aitrack/server && node packages/server/dist/cli.js serve
scripts.desktop: npm run build && npm run start -w @aitrack/desktop
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run dist -w @aitrack/desktop
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/core && tsc -p packages/server && tsc -p packages/ui && tsc -p apps/desktop
